biggest_catch: Requires $25,000 in new money within 90 days - a large deposit commitment; and the offer ends 2026-09-30 (8 days from verification). Platinum Perks has a $25 monthly service fee (waived with $25,000 in total relationship balances).
catches: Open a new Huntington Platinum Perks Checking account with your promotion code by September 30, 2026, applying online from the official offer page so the promotion code is claimed at account opening.

Make total new money deposits of at least $25,000 within 90 days from account opening; new money = money not currently on deposit in any Huntington account (except maturing personal CDs); transfers from another Huntington deposit account do not count.
Maintain an open account status in the eligible checking account for 90 days.
Available only to applicants residing in AL, AR, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MI, MN, MS, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, WV, or WI.
Only available to new personal checking customers; existing Huntington checking customers and those who closed a checking account within the last six months are not eligible.
One account-related gift incentive per rolling 12-month period across all deposit account relationships; cannot be combined with any other consumer checking offer.
Platinum Perks Checking has a $25 monthly service fee (waived with $25,000 in total relationship balances).
Bonus deposited into the new personal checking account within 14 days of meeting all requirements; Form 1099-INT issued for tax purposes.
